priorWording: Condition-specific reserve replacement could break the shared-scenario seed unit and paired oracle-minus-control comparisons.
methodConstraint: The E03 card defines an independent scenario seed shared across all six conditions; the registered full estimand includes five paired oracle-control differences.
replacementRule: An invalid registered primary run invalidates its six-condition scenario slot for paired primary analysis. Attempt every safely executable registered primary condition and retain all records. After primary collection, use the next unused ordered reserve scenario slot across all six conditions for each invalid paired primary slot, up to three. Never restart an invalid seed, replace by observed efficacy, or collect an unregistered reserve.
analysisRule: Only complete verified six-condition scenario slots enter the seed-level equivalence, oracle adequacy, and paired separation tests. Report valid-but-excluded companions, each invalid cause, the mapping from invalid primary paired slot to ordered reserve paired slot, and all unattempted reserves. If fewer than 25 complete verified paired slots remain, the full qualification is incomplete rather than passing or statistically negative.
stoppingRule: All 25 registered primary paired slots are attempted where safety permits; no outcome-dependent stopping or extension. A safety or integrity failure that prevents safe continuation remains a failed or aborted attempt and is not hidden by a reserve.
claimBoundary: This prospective clarification preserves the paired estimand and exact already-allocated 168-run maximum. It does not supply valid outcome data, waive invalid-run sensitivity, or authorize a full E03 packet before its collector and analysis are qualified.
